limitations: One clean 11-second, 22-word sample; no general accuracy claim.
Three tiny runs, one small run; no old small baseline.
Historical +3 baseline was measured earlier, not an interleaved controlled comparison.
First tiny run setup took 7069.858ms and remains included; its cause is not isolated.
MT request timers include client, network and service work; connectionReady is HttpClient.postUrl completion, not isolated network RTT.
Client persistence tested with local servers; live timing does not prove TCP reuse.
Accepted timing callbacks suppress canceled or stale work; request traces describe accepted current work, not authoritative billing.
No TCC/system-capture acceptance for this new package.
